MTC IDENTIFICATION AND AUTHENTICITY | | A1 | Verify MTC on manufacturer letterhead with unique cert number, date, and authorized signature/seal
Acceptance: Letterhead, number, date, authorized signatory present; seal affixed | Cl. 18 — Certification | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A2 | Verify heat/cast number on MTC matches mill marking rolled onto bars
Acceptance: Heat number rolled on bar; matches MTC and bundle tag; traceability intact | Cl. 17 — Marking | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A3 | Verify BIS/ISI mark and CM/L licence number printed on MTC and bundle tags
Acceptance: Valid CM/L number; ISI mark confirmed; licence currency validated online | Cl. 17 — BIS marking | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A4 | Verify manufacturer's name rolled on bar at regular intervals (for primary steel)
Acceptance: Maker's name/logo rolled on bar as raised characters; genuine primary-route steel confirmed | Cl. 17 — Rolling marks | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B. CHEMICAL COMPOSITION VERIFICATION | | B1 | Verify Carbon (C) percentage on MTC for ladle analysis
Acceptance: Fe 500: C ≤ 0.30%; Fe 500D: C ≤ 0.25%; Fe 550D: C ≤ 0.25%; within limits | Table 1 — Chemical composition | OK
NC
NA

Acceptance: Fe 500: S ≤ 0.055, P ≤ 0.055; Fe 500D/550D: S ≤ 0.040, P ≤ 0.040; sum S+P limited | Table 1 — S & P | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B3 | Verify Carbon Equivalent (CE) value on MTC, important for weldability
Acceptance: CE ≤ 0.53 (Fe 500 weldable grades); reported CE within specification | Cl. 8 — Weldability | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B4 | For IS 2062 structural steel — verify Mn, Si, Cr, Ni and micro-alloying elements
Acceptance: Reported chemistry matches grade (E 250 / E 350 etc.) chemical composition in IS 2062 | Table 1 — Structural steel chemistry | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C. PHYSICAL / MECHANICAL PROPERTIES VERIFICATION | | C1 | Verify Yield Strength (0.2% proof stress) reported on MTC
Acceptance: Fe 500: YS ≥ 500 MPa; Fe 500D: ≥ 500 MPa; Fe 550D: ≥ 550 MPa; reported YS exceeds minimum | Table 3 — Mechanical properties | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C2 | Verify Ultimate Tensile Strength (UTS) and UTS/YS ratio
Acceptance: Fe 500D: UTS/YS ≥ 1.08; Fe 550D: UTS/YS ≥ 1.08; ductility-critical per IS 13920 | Table 3 — Strength ratio | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C3 | Verify Elongation (%) at gauge length 5.65√A

NC
NA

NC
NA
